mapper.sql: action_template_id AS actionTemplateId, template_code AS templateCode, template_name AS templateName, action_type AS actionType, description, config_json AS configJson, status, version, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_workflow_action_template (action_template_id, template_code, template_name, action_type, description, config_json, status, version, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.actionTemplateId}, #{row.templateCode}, #{row.templateName}, #{row.actionType}, #{row.description}, #{row.configJson}, #{row.status}, #{row.version}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.updatedBy}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_workflow_action_template WHERE action_template_id IN #{id}

where.if: AND (template_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR template_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_workflow_action_template ORDER BY update_time DESC, action_template_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
